title: H423 — MTL-PEAD: Multi-Task Learning with Analyst Revision Auxiliary Signal
rationale: SSRN:5284651 proposes treating PEAD prediction as a primary task in a multi-task learning (MTL) framework, with analyst forecast revisions and institutional 13-F trading as auxiliary tasks. A shared encoder learns representations that generalize across tasks. The insight: teaching the model to predict analyst revision behavior forces it to internalize the forecast-revision cascade mechanism that drives PEAD. Expected improvement over H174's single-task FinBERT scoring: better generalization across companies and earnings regimes.
content: STUB — run_h423.py to be written when analyst revision data is confirmed available via FMP API (endpoint: /analyst-estimates/{symbol}/). Three task heads: (1) PEAD direction (primary), (2) analyst EPS revision direction (auxiliary), (3) institutional 13-F net buying direction (auxiliary). Shared FinBERT encoder with task-specific linear heads. Train IS 2013-2020; OOS 2021-2026. Gate: OOS WR > 81.8% with n >= 20 OOS events. Key risk: analyst revision data availability and frequency may limit sample size.
